title: Freya and the Echo Again
author: R. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Isandro Eastwick, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
